options.text: No risk at all.
options.misconception: it assumes no risk exists where the item shows one

options.text: Low market risk but high weather risk.
High market risk and low weather risk.
options.misconception: mistakes High market risk and low weather risk for Low market risk but high weather risk.

options.text: Only financial risk matters.

questions.explanation: Subsistence crops face weather risk but little market risk because they are not sold. At first glance tempting, "No risk at all." looks reasonable but does not hold up: it assumes no risk exists where the item shows one. A reasonable-sounding guess, "High market risk and low weather risk." is a seductive distractor: it reverses the risks. Easy to pick on a quick read, "Only financial risk matters." fails on closer inspection: it narrows risk to finance.

questions.topic: Risk profile of a subsistence crop

options.text: High market risk and low weather risk.
options.misconception: confuses High market risk and low weather risk with the supported claim Low market risk but high weather risk.

options.text: Low market risk but high weather risk.
No risk at all.
options.misconception: it assumes no risk exists where the item shows one

options.text: Only financial risk matters.

questions.explanation: Subsistence crops face weather risk but little market risk because they are not sold. A reasonable-sounding guess, "High market risk and low weather risk." is a seductive distractor: it reverses the risks. Easy to pick on a quick read, "No risk at all." fails on closer inspection: it assumes no risk exists where the item shows one. Superficially appealing, "Only financial risk matters." is a common wrong turn: it narrows risk to finance.
